text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Customer Xylon (enterprise, VPC) - eu-west-1 - p99 latency spike > SLA threshold (2xx requests). Summary: sustained p99 ~3.8s over last 5m, p95 ~1.2s. Affected: dedicated pool dx-pool-xylon-01, tenant traffic elevated. Paging: #oncall (raj-oncall)

maria-ops: Paging in. seeing alert, joining.

raj-oncall: I'm on it. first check: are there any recent deploys to dx-pool-xylon-01?

oliver-runtime: No deploys in last 24h. Noted kernel GC bump in node g-7 but unrelated.

kai-sre: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/xylon-eu-west?range=5m — baseline shows steady request rate but a burst of long tail across all backend replicas.

zane-support: Customer reported "sluggish responses" about 7m ago via support ticket #45321. They've degraded in-product search.

raj-oncall: Checking pool utilization... `rpoolctl describe dx-pool-xylon-01` -> replicas at 98% GPU mem, 6/8 nodes at >90% inference loop time.

maria-ops: Can we offload tenant to warm spare pool? Policy allows temporary burst to public-dedicated-fallback.

kai-sre: We can route a subset. Suggest canary 10% traffic -> fallback model quantized variant (gptq-2x) to reduce per-token latency.

raj-oncall: Initiating canary. Command:
```
redwood route update --pool dx-pool-xylon-01 --tenant xylon --percent 10 --target public-fallback-q1
```

incident-bot: Action logged: route update initiated by raj-oncall at 5398765448.

tess-am: Looping in account manager: @tess-am — I recommend we inform customer of mitigation and possible partial performance dev degradation due to quantized variant.

tess-am: Thanks — I'll draft a short status to Xylon: "We've detected elevated p99 in eu-west-1; we've routed 10% to a fallback variant to reduce latency. Engineers are investigating root cause; we'll provide an update in 15m."

zane-support: Customer-facing note WGTM. Add link to real-time logs: https://logs.redwood/xylon/eu-west/stream?from=now-10m

oliver-runtime: Seeing increased KV-cache misses for prefix keys for tenant xylon around 5398765420-5398765450 — TTL settings look correct though. Might be a cache eviction storm.

kai-sre: If cache churn, batching will slow down due to lower hit rate. Quick mitigation: raise prefix cache size for pool dx-pool-xylon-01 to 1.5x and rehydrate common prompts.

raj-oncall: Applying cache bump now: `rzctl pool-config set dx-pool-xylon-01 --prefix-cache-size 1.5x` -> applied at 5398765462.

incident-bot: Config change detected by raj-oncall. Monitoring p99.

maria-ops: Early numbers: p99 dropped to ~2.1s after canary + cache bump, p95 unchanged. Traffic still above baseline.

kai-sre: Recommend tenant isolation if tail persists: cordon noisy tenant endpoints and reassign to dedicated isolated pool while we run deeper GC/trace. This is heavier — will require customer signoff if we hit >30% degradation.

tess-am: Notifying Xylon that we may require temporary tenant isolation in worst case. They acknowledged and gave permission to proceed if we recommend it.

raj-oncall: OK. escalated to SRE lead for isolation approval. @kai-sre, prep steps for tenant eviction and reattach to isolated-pool-xylon-temp. Include session migration for active KV keys.

kai-sre: Prep done. Eviction window estimated 90s to cut traffic and warm new pool. We'll throttle connections during switchover to avoid 429s.

zane-support: Customer updated: "Thanks, we'll accept temporary switch if it improves latency."

raj-oncall: Executing isolation now: `redwood tenant isolate --tenant xylon --from dx-pool-xylon-01 --to isolated-pool-xylon-temp --grace 60s` -> started at 5398765490.

incident-bot: Tenant isolation started by raj-oncall at 5398765490. Expected downtime for affected sessions: <2min.

maria-ops: Isolation completed. p99 now ~0.9s, p95 ~0.8s. No 500 errors during switch, minor 429 spike for <30s.

tess-am: Notifying Xylon: "We've isolated your tenant to a temporary pool and latency is back to acceptable levels. We'll continue root cause analysis and follow up with a RCA."

oliver-runtime: Next steps: collect traces from before/after isolation, run heap/eviction analysis, roll forward cache policy fix, and consider autoscaling thresholds for dx-pool-xylon-01.

raj-oncall: I'll keep this thread open for postmortem notes and handoff. Oncall will remain until trace collection completes (~45m).

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Paging suspended. Please transition to post-incident review once traces uploaded.

maria-ops: Thanks team. Handoff to daytime rotation at 5398765505.

raj-oncall: Leaving notes in incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/5398765432 — tagging SRE, Runtime, Support, and PM.

kai-sre: Filed follow-up tasks: increase pool warm spare policy, improve prefix cache eviction metrics, and add canary runbook for quantized fallback.

zane-support: I'll draft the customer incident summary and send to Xylon with next steps and ETA for RCA.

maria-ops: Closing active warcoord. Great job everyone :thumbsup:
